actions.description: Copy multiple files or folders to new Dropbox paths in one batch job
actions.name: batch-copy-files-or-folders

entries.description: List of source and destination path pairs to copy

actions.description: Create multiple Dropbox folders in one batch request
actions.name: batch-create-folders

paths.description: List of paths to be created in the Dropbox. Max 10000 items. Example: ["/Projects/2024", "/Projects/2025"]

autorename.description: If there is a conflict, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the folder to avoid the conflict. Default: false

force_async.description: Whether to force the create to happen asynchronously. Default: false

poll_interval_ms.description: Polling interval in milliseconds when checking async job status. Default: 1000

max_poll_attempts.description: Maximum number of polling attempts for async job status. Default: 30

completed.description: Whether the batch operation completed successfully

async_job_id.description: The async job ID if the operation is still in progress

folders.description: Array of results for each folder creation attempt

total_count.description: Total number of folders in the batch

failure_count.description: Number of folders that failed to create

actions.description: Delete multiple Dropbox files or folders in one batch job
actions.name: batch-delete-files-or-folders

path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox to delete. Example: "/Homework/math/Prime_Numbers.txt"

entries.description: List of files/folders to delete. Each entry has a path field.

status.description: Status of the batch deletion operation

async_job_id.description: If status is in_progress, the job ID to poll for completion

entries.description: Results for each entry if the operation is complete

actions.description: Move multiple Dropbox files or folders to new locations in one batch job.
actions.name: batch-move-files-or-folders

from_path.description: Path of the file or folder to move. Example: "/folder/file.txt"

to_path.description: Destination path for the file or folder. Example: "/newfolder/file.txt"

entries.description: List of up to 1000 entries to move, each with from_path and to_path.

async_job_id.description: If job is in progress, this ID can be used to check status later.

actions.description: Check the status of a Dropbox batch copy job using its async job ID.
actions.name: check-batch-copy-files-or-folders

async_job_id.description: The async job ID returned by batch-copy-files-or-folders. Example: "dbjid:AAAcrHLQ..."

actions.description: Check the status of a Dropbox batch delete job using its async job ID.
actions.name: check-batch-delete-files-or-folders

async_job_id.description: The async job ID returned by batch-delete-files-or-folders. Example: "dbjid:AAAcrHLQ..."

status.description: Status of the batch deletion check

entries.description: Per-entry results when status is complete

actions.description: Check the status of a Dropbox batch move job using its async job ID.
actions.name: check-batch-move-files-or-folders

async_job_id.description: The async job ID returned by batch-move-files-or-folders. Example: "dbjid:AAAcrHLQ..."

actions.description: Check the status of a Dropbox unshare folder job using its async job ID.
actions.name: check-unshare-folder

async_job_id.description: The async job ID returned by unshare-folder. Example: "dbjid:AAAcrHLQ..."

actions.description: Copy a Dropbox file or folder to a different path.
actions.name: copy-file-or-folder

from_path.description: The path of the file or folder to copy. Example: "/folder/myfile.txt"

to_path.description: The destination path for the copy. Example: "/folder/myfile_copy.txt"

allow_shared_folder.description: If true, copy contents of shared folders.

allow_ownership_transfer.description: If true, allow ownership transfer for files in shared folders.

id.description: The unique ID of the copied file or folder

name.description: The name of the copied file or folder

path_lower.description: The lowercased path of the copy

path_display.description: The display path of the copy

actions.description: Create a folder at a Dropbox path.
actions.name: create-folder

path.description: The path in Dropbox where the folder should be created. Example: "/home/TestFolder"

autorename.description: If true, the folder will be renamed to avoid conflicts if a folder already exists at the given path. Default: false

actions.description: Create a shared link for a Dropbox file or folder with optional settings.
actions.name: create-shared-link

path.description: The path to the file or folder in the Dropbox account. Example: /folder/file.txt

settings.description: Optional settings for the shared link including visibility, audience, access level, password, and expiry.

requested_visibility.description: The requested visibility for the shared link. Can be public, password (link is publicly visible, but only accessible with the password), or team_only (only members of the same team can access).

audience.description: The audience of the shared link. Can be public (anyone with the link can access), team (only members of the same team can access), no_one (link is disabled), or members (only specific members can access).

access.description: The access level on the link. Can be viewer, viewer_no_comment (can view but not comment), editor, or owner.

allow_download.description: Whether to allow downloads via the shared link.

password.description: The password for the shared link. Required if requested_visibility is set to password.

expires.description: The expiration time for the shared link in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z).

url.description: The shared link URL that can be used to access the file or folder.

name.description: The name of the file or folder.

path.description: The lowercased full path to the file or folder.

link_permissions.description: The permissions associated with the shared link.

expiry.description: The expiration time of the shared link if set.

password_protected.description: Whether the shared link is password protected.

actions.description: Creates a user in Dropbox. Requires Dropbox Business.
actions.name: create-user

email.description: Email address of the new user. Example: "john.doe@example.com"

firstName.description: First name of the new user. Example: "John"

lastName.description: Last name of the new user. Example: "Doe"

actions.description: Delete a Dropbox file or folder by path
actions.name: delete-file-or-folder

path.description: Path to the file or folder to delete. Example: "/path/to/file.txt" or "/path/to/folder"

actions.description: Deletes a user in Dropbox. Requires Dropbox Business.
actions.name: delete-user

id.description: The team member ID of the user to delete. Example: "dbmid:abc123"

actions.description: Download file contents from Dropbox.
actions.name: download-file

path.description: The path of the file to download. Example: "/Homework/math/Prime_Numbers.txt" or "id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAYa"

actions.description: Download a Dropbox folder as a zip archive
actions.name: download-folder-as-zip

path.description: The path of the folder to download. Example: "/my-folder". Note: The root folder "/" is not supported.

actions.description: Retrieve the authenticated Dropbox account profile.
actions.name: get-current-account

actions.description: Retrieve metadata for a Dropbox file or folder
actions.name: get-file-or-folder-metadata

path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox to get metadata for. Example: "/folder/file.txt"

id.description: Unique identifier for the file or folder. Can be used instead of path. Example: "id:a4ayc_80_OEAAAAAAAAAXw"

actions.description: Generate a temporary Dropbox link for file content streaming.
actions.name: get-file-temporary-link

path.description: The path to the file you want a temporary link to. Example: "/folder/file.txt"

link.description: Temporary link to stream content of the file. Expires after four hours.

actions.description: List revisions for a Dropbox file by path or file id.
actions.name: list-file-revisions

path.description: The path to the file or a file ID. Example: "/folder/document.txt" or "id:a4aycG80J0UAAAAAAAAcZA"

mode.description: Specify how to interpret the path argument. "path" (default): revisions at the same file path are returned. "id": revisions for the file ID (survives moves and renames).

limit.description: Maximum number of revisions to return. Defaults to 10.

is_deleted.description: If true, this file was deleted.

name.description: The last component of the path (including extension).

path_lower.description: The lowercased full path in the user's Dropbox.

path_display.description: The cased path to be shown to the user.

id.description: A unique identifier for the file.

client_modified.description: For files, this is the modification time set by the client.

server_modified.description: The last modified time of the file.

rev.description: A unique identifier for the current revision of a file.

content_hash.description: A hash of the file content.

is_downloadable.description: If true, file can be downloaded directly.

has_explicit_shared_members.description: Whether this file has any explicit shared members.

cursor.description: Pass the cursor into files/list_revisions/continue to paginate through the entries.

actions.description: List Dropbox folder contents with pagination and optional recursion.
actions.name: list-folder

path.description: The path to the folder to list. Use "" (empty string) or omit for root folder. Example: "/Homework/math"

recursive.description: If true, list contents recursively for all subfolders. Default: false

include_deleted.description: If true, include entries for files and folders that were deleted. Default: false

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return per request (1-2000).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. If provided, continues listing from that point.

entries.description: The files and folders in the directory.

cursor.description: Cursor for retrieving more entries via list_folder/continue.

has_more.description: True if more entries are available.

actions.description: List shared folders available to the current Dropbox user.
actions.name: list-shared-folders

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return per request. Default is 100.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List shared links for the current user or for a specific path
actions.name: list-shared-links

path.description: Path to the file or folder to get shared links for. If not provided, returns all shared links for the current user.

cursor.description: Cursor returned from previous call to get the next page of results. Cursor is only returned when no path is provided.

direct_only.description: If true, only return links directly to the given path. If false or omitted, also return links to parent folders.

actions.description: Update settings on an existing Dropbox shared link.
actions.name: modify-shared-link-settings

url.description: URL of the shared link to change its settings. Example: "https://www.dropbox.com/s/abc123/file.txt"

settings.description: Set of settings for the shared link.

requested_visibility.description: Use `audience` instead. The requested access for this shared link.

audience.description: The new audience who can benefit from the access level.

access.description: Requested access level. Note: modifying access level for an existing link is not supported.

expires.description: Expiration time of the shared link in ISO 8601 format. By default the link won't expire.

require_password.description: Boolean flag to enable or disable password protection.

link_password.description: If require_password is true, this specifies the password to access the link.

allow_download.description: Boolean flag to allow or disallow download capabilities for shared links.

remove_expiration.description: If set to true, removes the expiration of the shared link.

actions.description: Move a Dropbox file or folder to a different path
actions.name: move-file-or-folder

from_path.description: The path to the file or folder to be moved. Example: "/Folder/File.txt"

to_path.description: The destination path, including the new name for the file or folder. Example: "/NewFolder/NewFile.txt"

allow_shared_folder.description: If true, move will take into account the shared folder permissions. Default: false

autorename.description: If true, rename will be attempted if a conflict occurs. Default: false

actions.description: Restore a previous Dropbox file revision to the current path
actions.name: restore-file-revision

path.description: The path of the file to restore. Example: "/Documents/example.txt"

rev.description: The revision ID to restore to. Example: "015a01044acb99900000001aa8954d0"

actions.description: Revoke a Dropbox shared link so it no longer grants access.
actions.name: revoke-shared-link

url.description: The URL of the shared link to revoke. Example: "https://www.dropbox.com/s/..."

success.description: Whether the shared link was successfully revoked.

actions.description: Search Dropbox files and folders by query text and path scope.
actions.name: search-files-and-folders

query.description: The string to search for. May match across multiple fields based on the request arguments.

path.description: A specific folder path to search in. If not specified, searches the entire Dropbox. Example: "/home/Documents"

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 100. Range: 1-1000.

file_status.description: Filter by file status. Default: active.

filename_only.description: If true, restricts search to file names only. Default: false.

file_extensions.description: Restrict search to specific file extensions. Only works for active files. Example: ["pdf", "txt"]

file_categories.description: Restrict search to specific file categories. Only works for active files.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit for the first page.

has_more.description: If true, more results are available

cursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page of results

actions.description: Turn a Dropbox folder into a shared folder for collaborators
actions.name: share-folder

path.description: Dropbox path to the folder to share. Example: "/my-folder"

force_async.description: If true, force the share operation to run asynchronously

member_policy.description: Who can be a member of this shared folder

shared_link_policy.description: Who can access shared links for the folder

viewer_info_policy.description: Whether to enable viewer info for this folder

actions.description: Unshare a Dropbox shared folder as its owner.
actions.name: unshare-folder

sharedFolderId.description: The ID for the shared folder. Example: "84528192421"

leaveACopy.description: If true, members of this shared folder will get a copy of this folder after it is unshared. Otherwise, it will be removed from their Dropbox. The current user, who is an owner, will always retain their copy.

actions.description: Upload a small file directly to Dropbox.
actions.name: upload-file

path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox to save the file. Example: "/folder/document.txt"

content.description: The file content as a base64-encoded string or raw string for text files.

encoding.description: The encoding of the content. Defaults to "utf8".

mode.description: Selects what to do if the file already exists. "add" will add a new file, "overwrite" will overwrite, "update" will update only if the revision matches (requires rev). Defaults to "add".

rev.description: The revision of the file to update. Required when mode is "update".

autorename.description: If true and there's a conflict, Dropbox will try to autorename the file to avoid the conflict. Defaults to false.

mute.description: If true, suppresses user notifications for this modification. Defaults to false.

client_modified.description: The value to store as the client_modified timestamp in ISO 8601 format. If not set, Dropbox uses the current time.

path_lower.description: The lowercase full path of the file.

id.description: The unique identifier of the file.

client_modified.description: The timestamp when the file was last modified by the client.

server_modified.description: The timestamp when the file was last modified on the server.

actions.description: Upload a large file to Dropbox with an upload session
actions.name: upload-large-file

file_content_base64.description: The file content as a base64-encoded string

dropbox_path.description: The destination path in Dropbox. Example: "/folder/file.txt"

mode.description: What to do if the file already exists. Default: "add"

chunk_size.description: Size of each chunk in bytes. Default: 4194304 (4MB). Max: 150MB

autorename.description: If true, rename the file if a conflict occurs. Default: false

mute.description: If true, suppresses email notification. Default: false

syncs.description: Sync Dropbox file metadata from configured root paths using list folder cursors.
syncs.name: files

syncs.description: Sync Dropbox folder metadata from configured root paths.
syncs.name: folders

syncs.description: Sync shared folder metadata visible to the current Dropbox user.
syncs.name: shared-folders

syncs.description: Sync Dropbox shared links for the current user or configured path scopes.
syncs.name: shared-links
